task-priority-changes.title: Change task priority
task-priority-changes.intro: Review the selected tasks and choose their new priority. Task status and delivery evidence are preserved.
task-priority-changes.no_changes: All selected tasks already have this priority.
task-priority-changes.version_exhausted: A task has reached its version limit. Review it before changing the batch.
task-priority-changes.incomplete: The selection is unavailable or contains an archived or deleted task. Update the selection to continue.
task-priority-changes.stale: The selected tasks changed. Refresh the workspace and review the selection again.
task-priority-changes.recovery_help: Check the original operation with its saved request and operation ID.
task-priority-changes.storage_help: The browser could not keep the recovery record. Check browser storage before trying again.
task-priority-changes.refresh_failed: The operation was recorded. Refresh the task list to see the current priorities.
task-priority-changes.access_changed: Project access changed. Check your access to continue.
task-priority-changes.access_invalid: The project access check could not be verified.
